title: Kutong language
description: Finisterre language spoken in Papua New Guinea
extract: Sakam, or Kutong, is one of the Finisterre languages of Papua New Guinea. It is the most divergent of its cluster, the Uruwa languages. It is spoken in Kamdaran, Makwa, Sakam, and Tamunat villages of Dinangat ward, Yus Rural LLG, Morobe Province.
